His Vimeo channel features detailed video analyses of professional swings, research presentations, and educational content that bridges the gap between academic biomechanics research and practical golf instruction. His work has contributed significantly to understanding how ground reaction forces, segment sequencing, and kinematic chain efficiency affect golf performance.
